'''Nabooian nerve knockers''' were a type of food<ref name="AS">''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]''</ref>&mdash;presumably originating from [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="WFG">In ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', the adjective "nabooian" was used to describe animal species from Naboo, like the [[Quadduck|nabooian waterfowl]].</ref> The [[Toong/Legends|Toong]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|benquadinaros|Quadinaros, Ben}}</ref> [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]] was reportedly very fond of nabooian nerve knockers.<ref name="AS" />
